rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user using full name and ZIP, looked up the correct pending order with the air purifier, and provided accurate status. However, when the user asked to modify the air purifier to the cheapest model, the agent executed the order modification without first stating the exact change (specific variant and price difference/refund method) and obtaining explicit confirmation, which the policy requires before any order-changing write. Although the modification itself and refund amount were correct and supported by tools, the missing pre-write confirmation violates the pass criteria. The subsequent request to refund to a gift card was handled consistently with the tool state (refund already processed to the credit card), but the earlier lack of confirmation remains a policy miss.
